name: JungleBank
tagline: A jungle-themed banking game that teaches children and teens about spending, interest and stocks.
problem: Young people learn little about money before they need it, the team says.
solution: A web platform where players track expenses, buy items to survive, learn interest and invest in stocks, earn coins in mini-games, talk to an AI banker and use voice control; scenes follow real day and night.
demo_moment: Team-described: earn coins in the treasure game, then invest them.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “3rd Place - General // 3eme place – Défi général” among 260 submissions.
Started from a sponsor's banking challenge and placed in the general ranking.

lessons: A sponsor brief can become an overall contender when framed for a wider audience.
